summary.description: One or two sentences: Codex's overall answer.

id.description: Stable identifier such as C1, C2. In a follow-up consultation, reuse the carried claim's id.

kind.description: fact = directly observed (file content, command output); inference = reasoned from observations.

evidence.description: file:line references or command/output excerpts supporting the claim; empty only when none exist.

followup_status.description: Follow-up consultations only: status of a carried claim, or new-blocking for a new blocking claim. null in an initial consultation.

open_questions.description: Questions Codex could not resolve and that would change its answer.
